note: Corpus callosum thinning/dysgenesis, ventricular enlargement, and white matter reduction are documented brain MRI features in DHX9-related neurodevelopmental disorder cohorts.

evidence.text: Brain imaging in individuals with monoallelic pathogenic DHX9 variants identified features including white matter volume loss, enlargement of the ventricles, and thinning of the corpus callosum.
